name: MS-01
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strongly Republican district with a PVI of R+18
Incumbent Trent Kelly running for reelection with a large cash advantage
No general-election polling or expert ratings available
Prediction markets price Kelly at roughly 95% to win
model.rationale: The fundamentals point firmly to Kelly: an R+18 district, incumbency, and a fundraising edge over Democrat Cliff Johnson, with markets pricing his win probability near 95%. With no polls or expert ratings to suggest movement, the forecast stays close to the fundamentals-based expectation of a double-digit Republican margin.
model.watch: Any late polling showing Johnson within single digits, or a surge of outside spending against Kelly, would be the first sign this race is competitive.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Trent Kelly seeks another term in this deep-red northeast Mississippi district, where the partisan lean favors Republicans by roughly eighteen points. He enters the general election with a clear financial advantage, holding about $864,000 on hand after raising just over $1 million, while Democrat Cliff Johnson has raised about $551,000 with $150,000 remaining. A Libertarian candidate is also on the ballot.

No public general-election polling covers the race, and no major expert raters have flagged it as competitive. Prediction markets give Kelly roughly a 95 percent chance of winning. Absent unexpected developments, the incumbent is positioned for a comfortable victory in November.
